adaptations: Introduce source-neutral ViewModel and ViewRow contracts.
Replace Graph imports with a host adapter for theme, classes, labels, chips, editors, and data formatting.
Keep the existing Kanban card, lane, drag, and keyboard interaction markup as the sole candidate implementation.
Use current Graph main as the canonical source snapshot; retain private internal extraction and defer consumer cutover until package rights, distribution, and parity gates pass.

Adapt the current Graph TableView and shared table-core visuals into Base; inject themes, responsive classes, rich cells, field controls, preferences, and data operations through neutral host adapters.
Adapt the current Graph row/column table visuals into one Base grid; inject Graph controls, themes, formatting, and data adapters through the Table host contract.
Adapt existing Graph settings controls into Base and inject host theme tokens, responsive classes, and input/select/checkbox controls through a versioned settings adapter.
Extract the responsive three-card dashboard layout as a neutral slot-driven component; preserve existing Graph accent classes and domain content in the host.

Move the existing DashboardCharts source into Base; replace the Graph model import with neutral series/tone types and map graph theme variables through --agentic-base-dashboard-* tokens. Keep D3 as a package peer dependency.
Move the existing DashboardWidgetBoard visual markup and responsive container-query CSS into Base; keep row calculation, drag state, keyboard policy, and persistence in the host adapter.
Move the native DashboardWidgetDisclosure presentation into Base with neutral CSS and controlled expanded/onExpandedChange props; preserve host-owned markdown title rendering and persistence.
Move the DashboardWidgetFlip selection, flip, sizing-slot, and keyboard shell into Base; inject the toolbar, editor/settings panel, resize handle, classes, and persistence from the host.

Move the DashboardWidgetContainer section/header/description/collapse presentation into a neutral slot-based Base component; keep dashboard visibility, heading content, expansion state, and persistence in the host.

Extract the existing Dashboard metric and card presentation shells into Base with a neutral stylesheet; inject titles, body content, footnotes, drag state, drop previews, and host-specific editing while reusing the shared neutral Kanban drag visuals.
Move the Dashboard rows-and-columns settings panel into Base; reuse the Base settings primitives and inject available layouts, state, save operation, and host-specific commands.

Move the generic Dashboard widget settings panel into Base using declarative field descriptors and existing Base settings primitives; inject Graph-specific sources, Markdown editing, values, commands, and persistence.
Move the existing Dashboard widget-template list wrapper into Base and compose Base's shared selectable widget frame with host-provided previews, toolbars, and configuration panels.
Move the Dashboard resize handle and size interaction into neutral Base components; host injects aspect ratio, min/max bounds, snap grid, and persistence callback.
Move pure Dashboard row reconciliation and responsive column sizing into Base; keep drag/drop policy, Graph snap-grid decoding, display state, and persistence in the host.
Move Graph DashboardCanvas responsive content layout into Base as a slot-based visual composition; consumers provide heading, chart, overview, metrics, sections, and actions.
Extract MainPanelSettingsPanelShell as a neutral settings presentation frame with theme variables; keep panel content, selection summary, and actions in the consumer.

Extract the Graph Workflow Manager list/detail composition and responsive split layout into the neutral FieldWorkbench; Base owns the reusable shell, search, sections, and selected-row visuals while consumers provide field models, schema, values, validation, actions, and persistence.

Centralize the existing Graph MainPanel section-header layout as SettingsSectionHeader; remove Graph store/theme imports and allow hosts to supply title, actions, and typography. Reuse it in the Base Workflow Manager field workbench.
Extract the existing FloatingPanel shell and close-control visuals into Base; keep placement, panel lifecycle, state, drag/pin policy, and content composition in each consumer.
Adapt existing Graph saved-view settings into the Base ViewSettingsPanel; keep query-specific field, filter, sort, group, and date sections in consumer-provided slots.
